scope: all rows; read original inputs; write only this new output directory
coordinate_crs: EPSG:4326 only if matching historical frozen source SHA and explicit CRS declaration; CityGML EPSG:6697 horizontal EPSG:6668
administrative_boundary: N03 2026-01-01 N03_007=13111; strict contains / boundary covers; metric distance EPSG:6677
town_boundary: 2020 Census local file CRS EPSG:4612; KEY_CODE=13111+chocho_code, allow polygon fragments of same code
boundary_review_note: audit screening tolerance; not asserted source accuracy; no coordinate correction
building_point_rules: raw lod0 roof/footprint polygon covers PASS; outside within 50m CONDITIONAL; outside over 50m FAIL; unavailable/invalid raw geometry HOLD; no geometry repair
building_usage: local original ZIP codelists/Building_usage.xml; 411-415 include housing; 461 unknown; 401-404,421,422,431,441,451,452,453,454 confirmed nonresidential according to codelist
road_model: frozen delivery-permitted lane graph with explicit connections, via/internal lanes, declared lateral restrictions; two BFS from depot (not OD generation, simulation or route optimization)
road_interpretation: graph reachability and source consistency are checked separately from real entrance/stopping feasibility; no claim of real access
old_demand: old parcel_equivalent used only for source aggregation conservation, never converted to new parcel_count
sampling: no S1-S3 demand sets generated; quota sufficiency evaluated from audited counts only
